title: Invoice total with per-line banker's rounding and tax applied once
contract: Each line extends to quantity * unitPrice rounded to scale 2 HALF_EVEN; extensions are summed to a subtotal; tax = subtotal * taxRate rounded to scale 2 HALF_EVEN is added once. Result has scale 2. Null/empty lines total 0.00 and null lines are ignored. Null or negative taxRate, negative quantity, and null or negative unit price all throw IllegalArgumentException.
expectedValuesFrom: Computed independently in Python with decimal.Decimal and ROUND_HALF_EVEN, not by running Solution.
notShownInJavadoc: tax applied once rather than per line
